Chicago Critical Mass

Chicago, IL · Loop · Social

Chicago Critical Mass is a social group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from Daley Plaza. Pace: slow mass ride. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow mass ride. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @chicritmass the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Chicago Critical Mass group ride

Thousands of riders leave Daley Plaza on the last Friday of every month, rain, shine or snow. Music, costumes, and a different route each time. Anyone on non-motorized wheels is welcome.
